description: What is physically loaded on the deck right now. This is the per-run file - edit it, do not edit deck.json or labware.json. Currently set up for protocols/centrifuge_test.py: 1.5 mL bracket in slot 5, tips in slot 3, a 96-well plate in each of slots 1 and 2, water at slot 9. The 0.65 mL holder that protocols/accuracy_test.py uses is OFF the deck, so that protocol will refuse until it is put back and re-added here.

placements.name: tips

corners.note: Three measured WELL CENTRES, not the box outline - the 100 x 63.7 mm span is far smaller than an SBS footprint. The grid is solved from these so real pitch and any rack rotation fall out of the measurement.

solved.note: col_pitch = 100.0/11, row_pitch = 63.7/7. Assuming the nominal 9.00 would accumulate ~1.0 mm of X error by column 12 - enough to miss a tip. Solved centre X 68.0 vs slot 3 centre X 65.0 is a 3.0 mm slot offset, which is what confirmed the x' = 420 + x frame.

placements.stale_note: The old TIP_X, TIP_Y = 218, 309 station in examples/300ulaccuracyprecision.py points nowhere near this box (X 18-118, Y 335.5-399.2). It is stale and is not carried forward.
placements.slot_note: Slot 3, operator-confirmed 2026-08-26. The measured grid centre (68.0, 367.35) is 3.0 mm in X and 2.35 mm in Y from the slot centre. The PREVIOUS tip rack was in slot 4, and the old scripts' TIP_X, TIP_Y = 218, 309 refers to that one in the pre-shift frame: +70 gives (288, 309), which is a corner well of a rack seated in slot 4 (336, 272). Both the rack move and the frame shift explain that stale coordinate; it is not carried forward.

placements.name: water
placements.near_slot_note: Sits in slot 9 (65, 178.5). Kept as a station rather than slot-mounted because the stored coordinate is a DIP POINT, not the trough's centre: (70, 175) is 5.0 mm in X and 3.5 mm in Y from the slot centre.

placements.name: big_tubes
placements.anchor_note: A1 is NOT stored here. It resolves from the labware's a1_from_slot_edge insets against slot 5's cell, which gives the measured (252.50, 305.50). Keeping the model rather than pinning anchor_xy means moving this holder to another slot is a one-line change - but see the caveat on those insets about the irregular slot pitch.

placements.name: plate1
placements.anchor_note: A1 is NOT stored. sbs_96_wellplate declares grid_centered_on_footprint, so lab/labware.py derives A1 from the slot centre and the grid span: A1 = centre + (-49.5, +31.5) for a 12x8 grid on 9.0 mm pitch. That puts A1 at (286.5, 396.5) in slot 1 and (150.5, 396.5) in slot 2, and both grids sit entirely inside their location cells.

placements.keepout_note: Columns 0 and 1 of this plate (X 150.5 and 159.5) fall inside the tip-ejector keep-out band X[148, 162]. They are not used by protocols/centrifuge_test.py, which targets columns 5 and 6 (X 195.5 and 204.5). Any protocol that does use them must have its routing checked - Machine._route_xy will refuse a tipped Y move there rather than risk the mechanism.
